summary: Search does not provide exact brand/product/color matching; it tokenizes and prefix-matches FTS, which can return irrelevant entries.
claim: Users cannot reliably search by exact brand/product/color as required; results may include unrelated items, failing acceptance.

evidence.source: MainViewModel.search builds FTS query as each term quoted + '*' (prefix) and only exact package ID via dao.byId(q). No exact equality queries on brand/product/color fields.

suggested_remediation: Implement exact field searches (e.g., WHERE brand = :q, product = :q, color_name = :q) or precise FTS phrase matching with field filters.
suggested_validation: Robolectric/instrumented test: searching exact existing brand string returns only entries with that brand; searching exact color returns only that color; package ID returns single entry.
